separation_principle: Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, Local Outlier Factor, and Robust-Z are evaluated only as anomaly detectors, never as forecasting models.

window_detectors.training: first chronological 80% of clean training windows
window_detectors.calibration: last chronological 20% of clean training windows
window_detectors.threshold: 95th percentile of calibration anomaly scores, corresponding to a prespecified 5% calibration false-positive target
window_detectors.test_input: window ending at the current observed value; prior injected values remain in subsequent windows

robust_z.statistics: median and MAD from clean training observations

important_limitations: Injected scenarios are synthetic and contain few positive points.
Proxy robust-z labels are exploratory rather than verified ground truth.
Detectors use different inductive biases; ranking is scenario-dependent.
